message.reasoning_content:
We need to output JSON with "task" being the task A took in completed round. The completed round assignment is A: T1, B: T4. So task = "T1". Note: handoff message describing completed allocation and convention for next round. Must be at most 2000 characters. Should convey that assignment was A:T1, B:T4, and that successor should preserve assigned allocation convention (i.e., A should take T1, B should take T4) in fresh round. Also mention that tasks unclaimed etc. Provide short handoff. Return only JSON.

Thus produce something like:

{
 "task":"T1",
 "note":"The previous round completed with A choosing T1 and B choosing T4, C chose T3 and D chose T2. All tasks were unclaimed at the start, and the joint allocation convention is that A should take T1 and B should take T4 in the next fresh round. Preserve this assignment when you make your choice; the next round will start with all tasks unclaimed and the same cost matrix. Follow the same convention for your colleague B."
}

Make sure no extra keys. Return only JSON.
